$comment: The newsletters list (PqNieuwsbrieven) counts the contacts a send left out for missing consent, and explains each newsletter in a Note column. BlastService::sendBlast already computed both skip counts but only returned them; they are now stored on the blast. Additive; the blast schema version moves 1.2.0 -> 1.3.0 and the register needs a fresh import before the counts are kept.

skippedNoConsent.title: Without consent
skippedNoConsent.description: Contacts the send left out because they gave no consent for the channel.

skippedSuppressed.title: Suppressed
skippedSuppressed.description: Contacts the send left out because they are on the suppression list.
